headline: Infosys, Mazagon Dock, and Coal India among stocks with record dates for dividends, splits, or bonuses between November 2 and November 8
hook: Upcoming record dates for major Indian stocks
summary: Several major Indian companies, including Infosys, Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders, Coal India, and Sanofi India, have announced corporate action record dates for the week of November 2 to November 8. These actions include dividend payouts, stock splits, and bonus issues. Shareholders owning the shares as of the record date will be eligible for these corporate benefits. Indian retail investors holding these stocks need to track these dates to ensure eligibility for the respective payouts and capital adjustments.
whats_next: Record dates falling between November 2 and November 8
why_it_matters: Hold shares by record date to claim dividends and bonuses

headline: Sanofi India Q3 net profit jumps 53.6 percent to Rs 117 crore
hook: Strong growth reported in September quarter
summary: Sanofi India reported a 53.6 percent year-on-year increase in net profit to Rs 117 crore for the third quarter. The pharmaceutical company also registered an expansion in its EBITDA margins during the period. The earnings reflect stronger operational performance for the listed firm. Indian retail investors tracking the pharma sector can evaluate this profitability growth against broader sectoral trends.
why_it_matters: Higher quarterly profit signals steady operational gains for Sanofi India holders
winners_losers: Sanofi India shareholders gain / peers unaffected

headline: Sanofi India declares interim dividend of Rs 75 per share
hook: Interim payout of Rs 75 per share
summary: Sanofi India Limited announced that its Board of Directors has declared an interim dividend of Rs 75 per equity share. The decision was made during the board meeting held on October 29, 2026. Eligible shareholders will receive this payout as part of the company's capital return. For Indian retail investors holding the stock, this cash distribution provides direct yield.
why_it_matters: Direct cash payout hits eligible shareholders' accounts.
winners_losers: Sanofi shareholders gain / company cash reserves reduced

hook: September quarter scorecard for Sanofi India
summary: Sanofi India Limited has submitted its unaudited financial results for the quarter and nine months ended September 30, 2026, to the stock exchanges. The filing provides a formal update on the company's financial performance and operational revenues for the period. Retail investors tracking the pharmaceutical sector can review these standalone or consolidated figures to assess margin trends and revenue growth. Earnings disclosures by established pharma players help gauge domestic healthcare demand and cost pressures.
why_it_matters: Quarterly earnings update for Sanofi India shareholders.

headline: Sanofi receives CDSCO approval for bleeding prevention drug in haemophilia
hook: New treatment path for haemophilia patients
summary: Sanofi India has received approval from the Central Drugs Standard Control Organization for its drug targeting haemophilia A and B. The approval covers adults and adolescents aged 12 and older, with or without factor VIII or IX inhibitors. This regulatory nod expands the company's specialized healthcare portfolio in the Indian market. For retail investors, regulatory approvals in specialized therapeutics broaden Sanofi's product pipeline and long-term revenue streams.
why_it_matters: Expands Sanofi India's specialized product portfolio.

headline: Sanofi India shares drop to 52-week low
hook: Five-day slide hits Sanofi India shares
summary: Sanofi India's stock price has declined for five consecutive trading sessions. This downward trend has pushed the share price to a new 52-week low. The company is a major player in the Indian pharmaceutical market. Retail investors holding the stock face potential valuation concerns following this sustained selling pressure.
why_it_matters: Portfolio value of existing shareholders faces downward pressure.
